fields.summary_ko.0: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B) has outperformed the S&P 500 by more than 5% over one week, reversing from being 13.6 percentage points behind year-to-date to now leading by 5.8 percentage points, as funds shift from technology stocks amid AI concerns.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 stock buybacks increased to $9.6 billion, more than double year-over-year, while approximately 106 million Google (Alphabet) shares held are under negative evaluation due to AI weakness.
